new_tail = old_tail + '''
    def run_main(self, argv):
        out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(out), redirect_stderr(err):
            code = todo.main(argv)
        return code, out.getvalue(), err.getvalue()

    def test_done_marks_item(self):
        todo.main(["add", "買牛奶"])
        todo.main(["add", "倒垃圾"])
        self.assertEqual(self.run_main(["done", "2"]), (0, "", ""))
        self.assertEqual(

    def test_done_missing_number(self):
        todo.main(["add", "買牛奶"])
        for number in ("2", "0", "-1", "abc"):
            with self.subTest(number=number):
                code, out, err = self.run_main(["done", number])
                self.assertEqual(code, 1)
                self.assertEqual(out, "")
                self.assertIn(number, err)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_main(["list"]), (0, "1. [ ] 買牛奶\\n", ""))

    def test_done_without_number_is_usage_error(self):

python3 - <<'EOF'
p = "todo.py"
s = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()

def edit1(old, new, tag):
    global s
    if s.count(old) != 1:
        print(f"⚠️ {tag}: 找到 {s.count(old)} 處，未改")
        return False
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
    print(f"ok {tag}")
    return True

edit1('"""待辦清單 CLI：add <文字>、list。',
      '"""待辦清單 CLI：add <文字>、list、done <編號>。', "docstring")

        return 0
''', '''            mark = "x" if item.get("done") else " "
            print(f"{i}. [{mark}] {item['text']}")
        return 0
    if len(argv) == 2 and argv[0] == "done":
        items = load()
        # isdecimal 擋掉負號與非數字；編號從 1 起算，對應 list 顯示的順序
        index = int(argv[1]) - 1 if argv[1].isdecimal() else -1
        if not 0 <= index < len(items):
            print(f"找不到編號：{argv[1]}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        items[index]["done"] = True
        save(items)
        return 0
''', "list+done")

feat: 新增 done <編號> 子指令，list 顯示完成狀態

- done 把 list 顯示的第幾筆標成完成；編號不存在（含 0、負數、非數字）時
  印錯誤到 stderr 並回 exit code 1
- list 每筆前面加上 [x]（完成）或 [ ]（未完成）；沒有 done 欄位的舊資料視為未完成

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
